_comment: Paragraph style CSS for alignment, word spacing and line breaking (#207). Read by alignment.test.js (buildStyleCssBlock) and tests/Unit/ParagraphStylesAlignmentTest.php (generate_style_css), so both generators are held to the same text. css is the whole output for style id 8; an empty string means the style writes no CSS.

cases.label: center only: just the guarded alignment rule
justify with a centered last line, word spacing and pretty
a last line without justify writes nothing
negative word spacing and balance, no alignment
fit to width writes none of them
end-aligned style with a hang turns the hang off
justified style with a hang keeps it
legacy id: every selector is guarded
